name: STARK — Paid Ad Strategy & Campaign Engine

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO campaigns (opportunity_id, name, platform, objective, target_audience_spec, ad_copies, proposed_daily_budget_vnd, max_total_budget_vnd, expected_cpl_vnd, status)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.opportunity_id ? "'" + $json.opportunity_id + "'" : "NULL" }},
  '{{ $json.campaign_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.platform.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.objective.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.target_audience_spec).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ ...$json.ad_copies, facebook_post: $json.facebook_post, post_content: $json.post_content }).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  {{ $json.proposed_daily_budget_vnd }},
  {{ $json.max_total_budget_vnd }},
  {{ $json.expected_cpl_vnd }},
  'PROPOSED'
)
RETURNING id, name, proposed_daily_budget_vnd, expected_cpl_vnd, status;
={{ $('Parse Campaign Plan').item.json.opportunity_id ? "UPDATE opportunities SET status = 'CAMPAIGN_CREATED' WHERE id = '" + $('Parse Campaign Plan').item.json.opportunity_id + "';" : "SELECT 1;" }}
